skill.name: seo-geo
skill.description: Audit websites for SEO and GEO readiness, generate structured data guidance, research keywords, and optimize content for search engines and AI answer engines.
skill.summary: Optimize websites for traditional SEO and AI search visibility.
skill.author: resciencelab

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, JSON-LD templates, placeholder URLs, and words containing key. Real risks remain from outbound website audits, DataForSEO API communication, and environment-based API credentials. No prompt-injection evidence was found.

remediation.issue: The SEO audit script can fetch arbitrary user-supplied URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Validate URL schemes and hosts, block localhost and private IP ranges, limit redirects, and cap response size before fetching.

remediation.issue: DataForSEO scripts read API credentials from environment variables and send requests to a third-party API.
remediation.suggestion: Document the outbound API use clearly, require explicit user consent before running paid API scripts, and recommend least-privilege credentials.

remediation.issue: A schema template includes a curl pipe-to-shell install example as placeholder text.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the install text with neutral signup guidance or a safer installation example that does not pipe remote content into a shell.

remediation.issue: Command examples can trigger network requests when copied or executed by an agent.
remediation.suggestion: Mark command examples as optional, require target-domain confirmation, and remind users to run them only for authorized sites.

semantic_findings.title: Unrestricted URL Fetching in SEO Audit Script
semantic_findings.description: The audit script accepts a URL argument and fetches that page, then derives robots.txt and sitemap.xml URLs from the same host. Without host validation, running it in a privileged agent environment could reach internal services or attacker-controlled hosts.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly uses user-provided URL input in urllib requests and derives additional URLs from that host. This is intentional SEO behavior, but the absence of host controls creates SSRF-style risk.

content.user_title: Optimize SEO and AI Search Visibility
content.value_statement: Search visibility is fragmented across Google, Bing, and AI answer engines. This skill audits pages, improves metadata, and creates schema for SEO and GEO workflows.
actual_capabilities: Audits page titles, meta descriptions, H1 tags, JSON-LD blocks, robots.txt, sitemaps, and load time.
Provides DataForSEO scripts for keyword ideas, related keywords, autocomplete suggestions, and SERP analysis.
Supplies schema templates for FAQPage, WebPage, Article, Product, Organization, SoftwareApplication, HowTo, and LocalBusiness.
Checks robots.txt guidance for Googlebot, Bingbot, ChatGPT-User, GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, and anthropic-ai.
Includes SEO and GEO checklists, platform recommendations, validation links, and report templates.
limitations: Scripts and command examples may make outbound network requests to target sites or third-party APIs.
DataForSEO workflows require DATAFORSEO_LOGIN and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD environment variables.
Ranking and AI citation recommendations need human review because search systems change often.
Schema templates are examples and must be customized before publishing.

use_cases.title: Audit a Marketing Website
use_cases.description: Find missing metadata, crawl access issues, schema gaps, and AI-search readiness problems before a launch.

use_cases.title: Prepare Structured Data
use_cases.description: Select useful schema types and create a validation plan for product, article, FAQ, and organization pages.

use_cases.title: Research Search Demand
use_cases.description: Use keyword, autocomplete, related keyword, and SERP scripts to plan pages around real search intent.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic SEO Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit for one public page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this page for title, meta description, H1, robots.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, and load time. Return prioritized fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Schema Markup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page and recommend the best schema types. Include required fields, missing data, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Improve GEO Content
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced content optimization for AI answer engines.
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize this article for AI search engines. Add answer-first sections, cited claims, statistics, FAQ questions, and concise summaries.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Competitive Search Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare our target keyword, competitors, SERP features, AI citation opportunities, schema gaps, and a 90-day action plan.

output_examples.input: Audit a SaaS homepage for SEO and GEO readiness.
output: Title is present but too generic for the primary keyword.
Meta description should add a clear benefit and target audience.
FAQ schema is missing and would help answer-engine extraction.
Robots.txt should mention major AI crawlers if access is intended.

output_examples.input: Improve a product article for AI answer engines.
output: Add a direct answer in the first paragraph.
Replace unsupported claims with cited statistics.
Add four FAQ questions that match buyer objections.
Create a validation checklist for the selected schema types.

output_examples.input: Plan keyword research for a new feature page.
output: Start with the primary feature term and two competitor domains.
Collect autocomplete and related keyword ideas.
Group opportunities by intent, difficulty, and page type.
Use SERP analysis to decide whether to build a guide, comparison, or landing page.

best_practices: Run networked audits only for domains you own or have permission to test.
Validate generated schema with Google Rich Results Test and Schema.org Validator before publishing.
Review all SEO and GEO recommendations against current brand, legal, and analytics requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not keyword-stuff pages or add unsupported statistics for AI visibility.
Do not publish example schema URLs, placeholder names, or sample prices unchanged.
Do not place API keys or DataForSEO credentials directly in prompts, files, or shared logs.

faq.question: What does this skill optimize?
faq.answer: It supports traditional SEO and GEO, which improves how AI answer engines find and cite content.

faq.question: Does it run a real website audit?
faq.answer: Yes. The included script can inspect metadata, JSON-LD, robots.txt, sitemap availability, and load time for a target URL.

faq.question: Does it need paid APIs?
faq.answer: Basic audits do not need an API. Keyword and SERP scripts require DataForSEO credentials.

faq.question: Can it create schema markup?
faq.answer: It provides templates and planning guidance for common schema types, but users must customize and validate the final markup.

faq.question: Is this useful with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What should users review before running scripts?
faq.answer: Users should confirm the target domain, expected outbound requests, and any DataForSEO credentials required for API workflows.
